Scoring_point_3_Problem_1.answer: Wrong invoice type submitted: The claim is for reimbursement of high-speed train tickets (Shanghai–Beijing round trip) for a professor attending a conference. However, the submitted invoice is a hotel invoice (Grand Hotel Beijing, CNY 1,200). According to the Reimbursement Policy, only official railway e-tickets or paper tickets are acceptable for train expense claims. Hotel invoices are not acceptable.
